name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower is a very common remodeling project. This transformation often involves removing the tub, modifying the plumbing for a shower drain, preparing the floor for a new shower pan, waterproofing the area, and then installing new wall tiles, fixtures, and a glass enclosure. It's an excellent way to update a bathroom, improve accessibility, and create a more modern aesthetic without major structural changes to the overall bathroom footprint. We can assess your current bathroom for feasibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting a bathtub to a walk-in shower is common. It involves removing the tub, adjusting plumbing, waterproofing, and installing new shower components.
